stable.notes: The menu-bar panel opens straight into itself: the unstyled Open Work button above it is gone, and Work opens from its chip in the Activity section like every other view. Includes 0.5.241: Work's Intake view, people on source meetings, Jev session suggestions, and Open in platform that opens the exact Claude session. Pairs with server 6.57.0.

notice.title: Right-click the pet
notice.body: Right-click the pet for Full motion, Calm motion or No motion, or to hide it. Hidden, it comes back from COS Control in the menu bar, under Session pet. The pet also shows Codex threads while they work and Cursor chats mid-turn.
